system.description: Whenever you create a device with the Improvised Device Talent, you can apply one modification granted by the Tech Specialist Feat to the device. This customization does not affect the value of the item being created.

prerequisite.text: Improvised Device talent, and Tech Specialist feat

nodes.text: Improvised Device talent, and Tech Specialist feat
